data.headline: NYSE-parent Intercontinental Exchange develops platform for 24/7 tokenized securities trading
data.summary: Intercontinental Exchange said on Monday that it had developed a platform for trading ​and on-chain settlement of tokenized securities, in a move ‌to capitalize on global demand for U.S. equities.  NYSE’s new digital platform - for ‌which it will seek regulatory approvals - will enable 24/7 operations, instant settlement, orders sized in dollar amounts, and stablecoin-based funding, the exchange said.  Investor appetite for nonstop trading in U.S. stocks has ⁠spiked in recent ‌years, which has prompted regulators to introduce new rules and approve proposals from major exchanges to ‍enable trading beyond normal market hours.
